description: Heads-up PLO4 (pot-limit Omaha, four cards) flop strategy from the blueprint, at 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100 or 200bb, for any of the 22,100 flops (any suits or card order). Returns the acting player's range-wide action mix and EV, how the other player's range answers each action, and, with `hand`, that four-card hand's action mix, EV and percentile in the range. BB acts first on the flop. Walk deeper by passing a returned nextLines value as `line`. Flop only: turn and river are not in the blueprint. Preflop heads-up PLO4 is the "plo4hu" preflop game.

hand.description: Optional exact four-card hand, e.g. AsKsQhJh

line.description: Flop actions before the decision, joined with "_", e.g. "BB_Check" or "BB_Check_SB_Bet50". Empty or omitted for the first decision.

preflop.description: Preflop line that reached the flop (default "SB_Open_BB_Call"). Others include "SB_Limp_BB_Check" and "SB_Limp_BB_Open_SB_Call"; a wrong value lists them.

name: get_hu_plo_flop

outputSchema.description: One heads-up PLO4 flop decision from the blueprint: the actor's range-wide action mix and EV, and one hand's strategy.

error.description: Present instead of a payload when the request named something that does not exist. No figure is estimated in its place.

flopLines.description: On a line error: the flop decisions after this preflop line.

hand.description: The asked hand: its group, whether it reaches this decision, per-action frequency and EV in bb, and rangePercentile (0-100: the share of the actor's range with a lower EV here).

line.description: Flop actions before this decision, e.g. "BB_Check"; "" is the first decision.

items.description: A line to pass as `line` next.

potBb.description: Pot before this decision, in big blinds.

preflopLines.description: On a preflop error: the lines that reach the flop.

range.description: The actor's whole range at this decision.

action.description: Action label, e.g. Check, Bet50, Raise100, AI.

avgEvBb.description: Range-weighted EV in bb, or null.

responses.description: For each action, how the other player's range answers it: action label to range-wide frequency at the next decision.

solvedAs.description: Present when the stored flop differs in suits or card order; every card in the answer is in your suits.

toCallBb.description: Amount to call, in big blinds.

title: Get heads-up PLO4 flop strategy
